items.fact: The campaign has five chapters and 91 story missions, according to PC Gamer's mission list. Other outlets give slightly different counts: GamesRadar says over 90, and Push Square and Insider Gaming say 93.

Chapter 1 is centered on the Leonida Keys, Chapter 2 on Port Gellhorn, Chapters 3 and 4 on Vice City, and Chapter 5 on Vice City and the wider state of Leonida. Chapter 5 is the shortest, with 7 missions.
Each chapter unlocks only after you finish every mission in the one before it. Completed missions cannot be replayed.
The protagonists are Jason and Lucia. You can only switch between them once the story reaches Vice City in Chapter 3.
Leonida is split into five counties. Places named in guides include Key Lento in Mariana County, Port Gellhorn, and Vice City in Vice-Dale County.
There are 18 collectible card sets across Leonida, and most sets hold 24 cards. Some sets are larger: Vice City Club de Futbol has 30, and several others have 36.
For 100% completion you only need 15 of the 18 card sets. One trophy needs just 3 complete sets.
The Progress menu tracks more than 250 animal species, including 61 hunting, 35 fishing and 60 bird entries.
There are 27 magazines, books and comics to find. They are counted separately from book swaps.
From Chapter 2, the mechanic Moses buys stolen cars that have no tracker. Randy, a high-end car fence you meet in Chapter 3, pays more for flashier vehicles.
Randy keeps a wish list of 18 high-end sports cars. Delivering one can pay $30,000 or more.
Late in Chapter 4 you learn to rob bank vaults, which can pay up to $200,000 per job. They also trigger an instant 4-star wanted level.
Late-game gang hideouts respawn and can pay roughly $10,000 to $30,000 per run. The big vault in each one comes back.
The Demolition Derby at Ambrosia Raceway pays about $3,800 to $6,300 per win. You can repeat it, and you win by default once every other car is wrecked.
Treasure diving for Kenton starts early in the game. He marks dive spots near Key Lento, and he pays tens of thousands of dollars if you find every piece at a spot.
There are 40 unique race locations. Entry and vehicle rental cost money up front, but a win pays more than you spent.
The Scooter Bros phone app lets you spawn, repair and impound-release your owned vehicles, but each use costs money. Premium costs $12,500 and gives three free uses per in-game day.
Jason's safehouse in Key Lento has a Dinka Enduro motorcycle and a Crest Kayak. These are Ultimate Edition items.
Robberies rated medium or high security are much easier as a pair. Check the map for back doors, and hold off on banks and loan stores until Chapter 3, when you get a dye pack jammer.
Fast travel works through buses and trains, which run on schedules. The RydeMe app also lets you fast travel from inside a ride for $100.
Two pre-launch updates came out, 01.002.000 on Nov 13 and 01.002.001 on Nov 16. Rockstar gave no patch notes for either.
Some PS5 players report a crash at the start of the prologue with error code CE-108255-1. Clearing the cache, rebuilding the database and reinstalling reportedly haven't fixed it.
A glitch lets players get into first-person view, which the game doesn't officially offer. Once it's active, you have to reload your save to leave it.
